title: Knowledge-Guided Vision-Language Inference for Image-Based Urban Flood Depth Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2509.04772v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Timely floodwater depth estimates support road accessibility assessment and emergency response during urban flooding. Supervised vision methods often require extensive labeled datasets, while recent foundation vision-language models (VLMs) offer flexible visual reasoning but can inconsistently yield large errors in metric depth estimation. This paper proposes FloodVision, a knowledge-guided framework for estimating flood depth from a single RGB image. FloodVision integrates a general-purpose VLM with FloodKG, a domain knowledge base encoding canonical object dimensions and component landmarks (e.g., wheel arch, curb top) to encourage reasoning at the component level rather than treating objects as wholes. This injects explicit geometric grounding without task-specific training. translated_title: 知识引导的视觉-语言推理用于基于图像的城市洪水水深估计
translated_abstract: 及时的洪水水深估计有助于城市内涝期间的道路通行性评估和应急响应。有监督的视觉方法通常需要大量标注数据集，而近年来出现的视觉-语言基础模型（VLMs）虽然提供了灵活的视觉推理能力，但在度量水深估计中可能不稳定地产生较大误差。本文提出了FloodVision，一个从单张RGB图像估计洪水水深的领域知识库（编码典型物体尺寸和部件标志点，例如轮拱、路缘顶部），以鼓励在部件级别进行推理，而不是将物体作为整体处理。这无需任务特定的训练即可注入显式的几何约束。在654张众包的MyCoast纽约洪水图像上（以居民报告的水深作为代理标签）进行评估，FloodVision降低了平均绝对误差……
tldr: FloodVision将通用视觉-语言模型与编码典型物体尺寸和部件标志点的领域知识库FloodKG相结合，无需任务特定训练即可从单张RGB图像中推理估计城市洪水水深，并在真实众包洪水图像上显著降低了水深估计误差。
en_tdlr: FloodVision integrates a general-purpose vision-language model with FloodKG, a domain knowledge base encoding canonical object dimensions and component landmarks, enabling training-free reasoning at the component level to estimate urban flood depth from a single RGB image with substantially reduced error.
